# Build System

---

## Overview

Touch Grass Bible uses [esbuild](https://esbuild.github.io/) as its bundler. esbuild is extremely fast (10-100x faster than webpack) and handles TypeScript, tree-shaking, minification, and source maps.

**Configuration file:** `esbuild.config.mjs`

---

## Build Configuration

```javascript
// esbuild.config.mjs
{
  entryPoints: ["src/main.ts"],  // Single entry point
  bundle: true,                   // Bundle all imports into one file
  outfile: "dist/main.js",       // Output location
  format: "iife",                 // Immediately-Invoked Function Expression
  platform: "browser",           // Browser target
  sourcemap: !prod,               // Source maps in dev, disabled in production
  minify: prod,                   // Minify in production only
  treeShaking: true,              // Remove unused code
}
```

### Mode Detection

```javascript
const prod = process.argv[2] === "production";
```

Pass `"production"` as the second argument to enable production mode:
```bash
node esbuild.config.mjs production   # Production build
node esbuild.config.mjs              # Development watch mode
```

### Banner

All output files include a banner comment:
```javascript
/*
THIS IS A GENERATED/BUNDLED FILE BY ESBUILD
if you want to view the source, please visit the github repository of this app
*/
```

---

## Metadata Generation

Before each build, `writeMetadata()` is called to:

1. **Update service worker version:**
   ```javascript
   // Sets the first line of src/web/service-worker.js:
   const VERSION = "3.1.1";
   ```
   This ensures the service worker cache is busted on each new version.

2. **Generate `src/info.json`:**
   ```json
   {
     "name": "Touch Grass Bible",
     "description": "...",
     "version": "3.1.1",
     "build": "2024-01-15T10:30:00.000Z",
     "author": "Justice Vellacott",
     "license": "MIT"
   }
   ```
   Version is read from `process.env.npm_package_version` (set by npm when running scripts).

---

## Watch Mode vs. Build Mode

### Watch Mode (development)

```bash
npm run dev  # or: node esbuild.config.mjs
```

- esbuild watches all imported files for changes
- Rebuilds incrementally on any change (typically < 100ms)
- Source maps enabled for debugging
- No minification

### Production Build

```bash
node esbuild.config.mjs production
```

- Single build pass then exits
- Minification enabled (all whitespace and comments removed)
- No source maps
- Tree-shaking removes unused code
- `process.exit(0)` called after build completes

---

## NPM Scripts

| Script | Command | Description |
|--------|---------|-------------|
| `npm run dev` | `node esbuild.config.mjs & npm run serve` | Dev server + file watcher |
| `npm run serve` | `live-server ./dist --port=3000 --browser=firefox` | Dev HTTP server |
| `npm run build` | `npm run getdatafiles && node esbuild.config.mjs production` | Full production build |
| `npm run build:web` | `mkdir -p ./dist && npm run build && cp src/web/* dist` | Web/PWA build |
| `npm run build:electron` | `... && cp ./src/electron/* ./dist && cd dist && npm install && npm run start` | Electron build |
| `npm run build:capacitor` | `npm run build:web && npx cap sync` | Mobile build |
| `npm run getdatafiles` | `node ./processing/online.mjs && cp src/translations.json dist` | Data pipeline |
| `npm run clean` | `rm -rf ./dist/* ./dist/` | Clean build output |
| `npm run lint` | `eslint src/*.ts` | ESLint check |
| `npm run format` | `prettier --write "src/**/*.ts" && prettier --write "*.md"` | Code formatting |
| `npm run run:embed` | `esbuild ... && node processing/embedding.js` | Generate embeddings |
| `npm run run:android` | `npx cap run android` | Run on Android device |
| `npm run run:ios` | `npx cap run ios` | Run on iOS device |
| `npm run sync:capacitor` | `npx cap sync` | Sync Capacitor plugins |

---

## Build Output

After `npm run build:web`, the `dist/` directory contains:

```
dist/
├── main.js              # Bundled, minified TypeScript app (~300-500 KB)
├── translations.json    # Bible text for KJV/YLT/ASV (~12 MB)
├── crossrefs.json       # Cross-references (~5 MB)
├── topics.json          # Topics (~10 MB)
├── index.html           # Web entry point
├── manifest.json        # PWA manifest
├── service-worker.js    # Offline support
├── icon-192.png         # App icon 192x192
└── icon-512.png         # App icon 512x512
```

## ESLint Configuration

**File:** `eslint.config.mjs`

```javascript
import js from "@eslint/js";
import tseslint from "typescript-eslint";
import globals from "globals";

export default tseslint.config(
  js.configs.recommended,
  tseslint.configs.recommended,
  {
    languageOptions: {
      globals: {
        ...globals.browser,
        ...globals.node,
      },
    },
  },
  {
    // Electron-specific override
    files: ["src/electron/**/*.js"],
    rules: {
      "@typescript-eslint/no-require-imports": "off",
    },
  },
);
```

## TypeScript Configuration

**File:** `tsconfig.json`

```json
{
  "compilerOptions": {
    "target": "ES2020",
    "lib": ["es2023", "DOM", "DOM.Iterable"],
    "strict": true,
    "noUnusedLocals": true,
    "noUnusedParameters": true,
    "module": "ESNext",
    "moduleResolution": "bundler",
    "esModuleInterop": true,
    "skipLibCheck": true,
    "resolveJsonModule": true
  }
}
```

Key settings:
- **`moduleResolution: "bundler"`** — Modern resolution compatible with esbuild
- **`resolveJsonModule: true`** — Allows importing `.json` files (used for `info.json`)
- **`strict: true`** — All strict checks enabled
- **`noUnusedLocals/Parameters: true`** — No dead code allowed
